title: Fleet capacity-lane autoscaler and burst-credit circuit (capacity lanes + telemetry v2)
author: Maya Chen
body: Context: Large tenants intermittently exhaust reserved capacity during predictable mid-day spikes. Existing warm-pool/autoscaler logic reacts globally and mixes opportunistic capacity with reserved commits, which causes noisy degradations for guaranteed throughput workloads. This PR implements a capacity-lane concept (reserved / burst / opportunistic lanes) plus an internal "burst-credit circuit" that safely bottles and routes short-duration credits between lanes under strict isolation and accounting. Goal: provide predictable throughput guarantees for dedicated tenants while allowing controlled short bursts and improved global utilization. Design summary: - Introduce CapacityLane enum and per-pool lane quotas (configurable in DedicatedPool CRD). - Lane-aware autoscaler: the lane autoscaler maintains target allocations per lane using independent SLOs (reserved: throughput floor, burst: short window peak, opportunistic: maximize utilization). - Burst-credit circuit: a credit ledger that mints short-lived burst tokens from idle opportunistic capacity and routes them through a ring buffer to burst lanes. Credits are timeboxed, decayed, and reconciled by the circuit controller to avoid double-spend on preemptible hosts. - Spillover isolation fence: when lane invariants are violated (e.g., reserved throughput below threshold), the fence prevents further cross-lane credit transfers and triggers a conservative slow-path that sheds opportunistic work. - Utilization gradient reporter (telemetry v2): new telemetry streams emit per-lane utilization histograms, burn-rate percentiles, and a compact credit-lifecycle trace to aid debugging and billing reconciliation. Backwards compatibility: defaults keep current behavior unless pools opt-in via the new DedicatedPoolConfig (opt-in rollout). Migration: cluster operator can enable lanes progressively per cluster/region, and an operator job migrates existing warm-pool allocations into lanes with a safety window. Checklist: - [x] API: DedicatedPoolConfig & tenant annotations - [x] Runtime: lane-aware allocator and autoscaler - [x] Controller: burst-credit circuit controller with reconciliation loop - [x] Telemetry: per-lane histograms and credit-lifecycle traces - [x] E2E tests: deterministic surge test and credit expiry test - [x] Docs: design doc and runbook Changes included (high level): - pkg/autoscaler/lane_autoscaler.go: new lane-aware scaling logic and SLOs. - pkg/fleet/credit_circuit.go: credit minting, routing, decay, reconciliation. - controllers/dedicatedpool/config_types.go: new DedicatedPoolConfig CRD fields and validation. - observability/telemetry/v2/usage_histograms.go: per-lane histograms, percentiles, credit trace emitter. - test/e2e/capacity_lane_integration_test.go: deterministic surge, spillover and reconciliation scenarios. Runtime knobs (configurable): - reserved_min_throughput: token/sec floor for reserved lane - burst_window_seconds and burst_rate_limit: controls burst token issuance - opportunistic_decay_secs: how fast opportunistic credits expire - spillover_fence_threshold_pct: percent below reserved_min to trigger fence Observability & alerts added: - Alert: ReservedThroughputBreach (fast path) when reserved_lane falls below 95% of floor for 30s - Alert: CreditLeakCandidate when credits are not consumed and not decayed for > 10m - Dashboards: per-pool lane utilization, credit ingress/egress, credit age distribution Rollout plan: 1) Feature gated behind DedicatedPoolConfig.featureGates.CapacityLanes 2) Canary on one staging region, synthetic workload for reserved & burst tenants 3) Gradual opt-in per-customer with operator migration job 4) Full cluster-wide opt-in after 2 weeks of canary metrics and no safety alerts Testing: unit tests for ledger invariants, e2e deterministic surge harness, and a stress run with mixed tenant shapes Observability notes: histograms are emitted at 10s resolution and compacted to 1m in the backend to keep cardinality contained. Billing reconciliation: credit lifecycle traces provide the ledger id and timestamps to match consumed credits to downstream billing events Docs & runbook: docs/design/capacity-lanes.md contains the operator migration steps and recommended tuning for 95th/99th percentile latency sensitive tenants. Related: ENG-1968 (throughput guarantees) and PM-421 (customer ask: peak-exhaustion during mid-day spikes).

review_comments: Liam O'Connor (requested changes) @maya: The autoscaler loop looks good, but we need stronger backpressure when opportunistic hosts are marked draining. Please add poison-pill logic so credits in-flight to draining hosts are immediately invalidated and returned to the ledger.
Maya Chen (author reply) @liam added poison-pill handling in credit_circuit.go and a unit test for ledger rollback; expanded documentation to call out preemptible host handling.
Sofia Martinez (comment) Can we add a short note in the runbook about expected billing artifacts for consumed burst credits? Customers ask for transparent mapping between credits and invoices.
Maya Chen (author reply) @sofia added credit-lifecycle trace fields that include ledger_id and tenant_tag; runbook updated with reconciliation snippet.
Arjun Patel (approval) Verified e2e deterministic surge: reserved tenant maintained 99.9% of floor, opportunistic utilization improved ~7%. Approving for merge.
release_notes: Adds capacity 'lanes' for Dedicated pools (reserved/burst/opportunistic), a burst-credit circuit for controlled short bursts, lane-aware autoscaling, and per-lane telemetry. Opt-in via DedicatedPoolConfig.featureGates.CapacityLanes. See docs/design/capacity-lanes.md for operator migration and tuning guidance.
notes_for_release: This feature is opt-in. Operators should run the provided migration job on a canary pool before enabling cluster-wide. Default config preserves current behavior. Backwards incompatible changes: none.
post_merge_actions: Deploy feature gate to staging and run synthetic reserved+burst workload
Monitor ReservedThroughputBreach and CreditLeakCandidate alerts for 48h
Coordinate with billing team to validate credit-lifecycle traces against test invoices
